title: Docs match Cognito password login
description: Operator docs still tell people auritus login is Google OAuth/PKCE. Update README, docs/SELF_HOSTING.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/ACCEPTANCE.md, and site self-hosting page to USER_PASSWORD_AUTH: auritus login --username.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: PR #12 opened: operator docs and README use auritus login --username; Google is optional IdP only.

right_now_summary: A PR updates operator docs to use username/password login, with Google noted as an optional provider.
